mainEntity.name: What kind of exercises are included in a Core Sculpting session?

acceptedAnswer.text: Core Sculpting sessions at Cave Training incorporate a variety of functional exercises beyond traditional crunches. You can expect movements like planks, dead bugs, bird-dogs, rotational exercises, and anti-extension movements, often utilizing equipment like kettlebells, medicine balls, and resistance bands. The focus is on engaging multiple core muscles simultaneously to build comprehensive strength and stability. Process Clarity: Each session is structured to progress systematically, challenging your core from different angles to ensure balanced development.
